notes.title: 24-HOUR FLASH GIVEAWAY!
notes.content:
FMV fans rejoice! Today, we're starting a 24-hr flash giveaway for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1490840/Bloodshore/]Bloodshore[/url], the new interactive action-adventure movie from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/WalesInteractive]Wales Interactive[/url], publishers of The Complex, Five Dates, Maid of Sker and more! We're giving away the ENTIRE Wales Interactive collection plus loads of runner-up Steam keys for Bloodshore, exclusively to you on Steam!

[h3]PRIZES[/h3]
[b]1st:[/b] Bloodshore key + every game listed [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/WalesInteractive]here[/url]
[b]2nd: [/b]Bloodshore key + three games of your choice
[b]3-10th:[/b] Bloodshore key

[h3]HOW TO ENTER[/h3]
[b]1. [/b]Add Bloodshore to your Steam Wishlist
[b]2. [/b]Visit the Bloodshore store page and click the "Follow" button
[b]3. [/b]Head over to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1490840/view/3076515048881293292?utm_source=steam_community&utm_medium=master_reboot&utm_campaign=flash_giveaway]Official Steam Giveaway Post[/url] and leave a comment

[i](Please be honest with us, it only takes a second to Wishlist/Follow and it greatly supports the devs)[/i]

notes.title: Soul Axiom Has Arrived On Steam!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/lrvR5QJ.jpg[/img]

[h1]Launch Trailer[/h1]
Hi everyone! The time has finally come for Soul Axiom, the spiritual successor to Master Reboot, to leave Early Access and what better way to celebrate than to [b]slash 30% off for the entire week?[/b]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/279900/

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XRiGWOZ8DOg
Gamers will also have the chance to buy the DLC content, almost two years in the making, featuring an 85-page digital art book with designs from Senior Artist, Chris Phillips and a two-hour long soundtrack by Music & Sound Engineer, Gareth Lumb. The 30% discount applies to all options including the DLC only, the Deluxe Edition and the Super Deluxe DLC bundle. The DLC standalone content has been unlocked and will shortly be lined up with the rest of the bundles on the store page. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/by0aIRp.jpg[/img]

Want to know more about the game? Soul Axiom is a first-person, story-driven adventure game, set in the beautiful, haunting cyber-world of Elysia. Collect unique hand powers in this compelling cyber-thriller to solve puzzles, manipulate the environment and unlock the path to your adventure. Immerse yourself in a dramatic story with over 20 hours of gameplay and 40 distinct locations to explore. Choose your destiny and discover multiple endings as you unravel the mysteries of your digital afterlife.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/94DCxTE.jpg[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/g3Ixw4I.jpg[/img]

The Wales Interactive team have lined up several gaming events to celebrate the launch of Soul Axiom so if players would like to meet the team then we’ll be around at the following event:

[h1]PCGamer Weekender[/h1]
[h1]Insomnia57[/h1]
[h1]GDC San Francisco[/h1]
[h1]EGX REZZED[/h1]

We hope you all enjoy the final version of Soul Axiom.

Wales Interactive.

notes.title: Game Connection Awards – We need your votes!
notes.content:
[img] http://i.imgur.com/3eF76l9.png[/img]

Hi all! We’ve had some great news from the [b]Game Connection America 2016 Awards[/b] and that is Soul Axiom has been nominated for the “Best Console/PC Hardcore” award and is automatically put through for a chance to win the “People’s Choice Award”. 

The game with the most votes wins! The voting takes place on Facebook and needs your “Like” on the photo below! If you want to see the game win this incredible award then get Liking that photo and don’t be afraid to spread the word and ask your friends :D

[h1]LIKE / VOTE >>>>>>>>>>>>>>[/h1]https://www.facebook.com/1567390850246256/photos/a.1567393186912689.1073741827.1567390850246256/1567410543577620/?type=3&theater

We are just 1 of 2 UK games nominated at the awards and were chosen from 170 international games across 12 categories… how awesome is that?

Thank you all for your support and fingers crossed for the big day on March 14th, San Francisco.

Wales Interactive Team
